comments.value: It would be nice to have more options, I currently make avatars for friends and the cloning feature is way more conenient for sharing it with them, rather than needlessly making a private avatar world.

I agree with BadWolf, it should have similar functions to the instance types. though having it friends+ would be pretty much the same as having it public. you just have to be friends with one person who has the avatar to gain access to it.
Definitely great for totally-not-alternate-accounts and friends. Would also be cohesive to the friends list feature, giving friends of that user access to more content!
Ever since cloning came out weve asked for something like this, or a "pedestal only" option. Its been quite a while since

While options are generally a good thing there is a point where too many options interferes with a good UI. I think this starts down that path. If I want to restrict cloning for a friend (why all friends after all?) I could just invite them into my home world (they are my friend) and do the cloning there.

author.name: Scout - VRChat Head of Quality Assurance

comments.value: @{602d3bd675defb333e431d1b|full_name} A lot of people make avatars public for cloning amongst friends but don't want just anyone to get those avatars or for them to pop in avatar search worlds. This is something that I think is a good idea for that reason alone. I'm desperate for some kind of "ownership transfer" or "friends only" cloning solution.

@{5f4f292e76875549af048b8d|full_name} The point was (and I wrote that) :-) why just a friends option? And using your example how do you prevent your friends (possibly 100s of them) from letting their friends clone them? A well-designed solution should ultimately be the goal.

@{602d3bd675defb333e431d1b|full_name} Ideally, I'd rather there be a one time use token system or something like again, ownership transfer, where the original author can hand out tokens to specific people. My main issue with avatar cloning right now isn't what you mentioned about friends sharing avatars with people - I trust my friends and most commission me and understandably don't want just anyone having the avatar, either. I take issue with avatar search worlds, especially ones where the creators of them make it difficult to contact them or simply don't respond when contacted. In my opinion, a solution for this should have been made and prioritized a long time ago, especially since VRC wants a whole "creator economy" or whatever.

I personally always leave cloning on cause it doesn't affect private avatars (meaning personal ones I uploaded to my account). I would also like to ask for a clarification in the menu stating that turning cloning on won't magically let someone steal your personal custom avatar, I think more people would be willing to have cloning on if they knew that.

@{602d3bd675defb333e431d1b|full_name} There are already options for everything else like Worlds, Portals, and Groups, cloning feels overlooked for so long.  Could be setup the same as Worlds easily, a Friends+ means that Friends of Friends can clone the avatar, just like Friends of Friends can join worlds, what's the difference?

@{68101580c2584ec1a1903aaf|full_name} I don't honestly care who copies what or whether anything makes sense in the end BUT I will suggest that joining an instance of a world marked Friends+ isn't the same as cloning an avatar. I frequently create an instance of my private world, I mark it Friends+ . That means people can join. If instead they copied my avatar their friends, etc. could clone it ad infinitum. An asset is not the same as a world. In any case what does "a friend" mean in the context of VRC? It is a button click.

@{602d3bd675defb333e431d1b|full_name} I'm sorry you have zero value in those you add to your friends list like that. The definition of a Friends+ instance means that anyone who is a friend of a friend (daisy chaining to infinity) can join that instance, and the same concept would apply to a Friends+ Avatar Cloning restriction in my example, I'm sorry you don't understand that.

@{68101580c2584ec1a1903aaf|full_name} I believe I understand the concept of "friend". I hear people gossip about their VRC friends all the time. People accept friend requests and remove them periodically. Some people are on friends lists because they need to know where those people are because they are pests. The reality is one often wants to share "something" with those around them and not necessarily forever and especially friends of friends of friends.

This wasn't possible in the past because of client users (due to how cloning and avatar ownership is designed), but now that we have Easyanticheat, I think the client-side verification might be good enough
Now with the Groups implementation, we could have Group cloning too, for just sharing your creations with your community

details: Instead of making Cloning for everyone, maybe an avatar creator or someone using an avatar can set the avatar for friend cloning only
title: Cloning Only For Friends
